raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The prefill delayer's queue trigger (`--prefill-delayer-queue-min-ratio`, #23189) should hold prefill until the queue reaches `running_req * ratio` or `--prefill-delayer-max-delay-ms` elapses, but on main it ends its own delay in three ways; this PR removes all three.

1. **The threshold collapses toward the queue.** Without `--prefill-max-requests` it is capped by the `max_prefill_bs` high-watermark, which delayed passes feed with the waiting-queue length (#34284). #35191 fixed this only when a request limit is set.
2. **A queue-only delay consumes the one-shot `skip_first_delayer` bypass** meant for the slot trigger's first `merge_batch`.
3. **`max_delay_passes` (#32880) also bounds queue delays**, so 30 passes end them long before the 5000 ms default.

## Modifications

- The threshold is `running_req * ratio`, capped only by a configured `--prefill-max-requests`.
- `skip_first_delayer` is consumed only when the slot condition holds.
- Queue-triggered delays are bounded by `max_delay_ms` alone (TP0 decides it since #42625); slot-only delays keep `max_delay_passes`.
- Help text and docs updated. Except for keeping the static cap, this is #34806 by @xdtbynd (closed unreviewed), credited as co-author.
- With the queue trigger off, `queue_condition` is always false and behavior matches main.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: only admission timing changes.

`test_prefill_delayer_high_watermark.py` adds five CPU cases: one per defect, plus the `prefill_max_requests` cap and the slot-only pass bound. On main exactly the three defect cases fail; reverting one fix fails only its case. With `test_prefill_delayer_gather.py` and `test_server_args_docs_coverage.py`: 15 passed, 8 subtests passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Prefill fragmentation (`Prefill batch` log lines), MI355X, TP=1, dummy weights, `main@ef867fa40d` vs. this PR; ratio 0.13, max delay 870 ms, `bench_serving` random 211/389, 613 prompts, concurrency 173; median of 3.

| model | prefill batches main → this PR |
|---|---|
| gpt-oss-120b / Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct | 53.5 → 29 / 55 → 29 (−46 % / −47 %) |
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3 (reduced layers), Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | −50 % each |
| queue trigger off (Llama) | 271 → 270 |
| `--prefill-max-requests 37` (Llama / gpt-oss) | −9 % / −12 % (defect 3) |

**Trade-off:** delays now last as long as configured, so median TTFT rises 39–66 %, TTFT p99 sits near `max_delay_ms` on four of five models, and median TPOT improves 2–7 %.

Open questions: should the 5000 ms default come down now that it binds, and should an explicit `--prefill-delayer-max-delay-passes` still bound queue delays? Affected: GLM-5.2 B200 AgentX launches, the Ascend Qwen3.6-27B recipe (300 passes), and the NPU Qwen3.6-27B GPQA test, where a queue delay can now last 30 s.

cc @paulzhang-tm: this drops the `max_prefill_bs` fallback kept in #35191.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -113,5 +116,102 @@ def test_queue_timeout_follows_gathered_flag(self):
                     self.assertEqual(kwargs["queue_timeout_expired"], local_expired)
 
 
+def _gather_on_one_rank(output, local, group=None):
+    output.copy_(local)
+
+
+# 50 running at ratio 0.3 wait for 15 queued; 974 free slots keep the slot
+# trigger off.
+_QUEUE_ONLY_PASS = dict(
+    local_prefillable=True,
+    token_usage=0.5,
+    running_batch=50,
+    max_prefill_bs=16,
+    max_running_requests=1024,
+    waiting_queue_len=2,
+)
+
+
+class TestPrefillDelayerQueueTrigger(CustomTestCase):
+    """A queue-triggered delay holds until the waiting queue reaches
+    running_req * ratio or max_delay_ms elapses, whichever comes first."""
+
+    def make_delayer(
+        self, *, queue_min_ratio=0.3, max_delay_passes=30, prefill_max_requests=None
+    ):
+        stack = ExitStack()
+        self.addCleanup(stack.close)
+        stack.enter_context(
+            published_topology(
+                enable_prefill_delayer=True,
+                prefill_delayer_queue_min_ratio=queue_min_ratio,
+                prefill_max_requests=prefill_max_requests,
+            )
+        )
+        stack.enter_context(
+            get_parallel().override(
+                tp_group=SimpleNamespace(cpu_group=None, device_group=None)
+            )
+        )
+        stack.enter_context(
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.managers.prefill_delayer.all_gather_single",
+                side_effect=_gather_on_one_rank,
+            )
+        )
+        delayer = PrefillDelayer(
+            max_delay_passes=max_delay_passes, token_usage_low_watermark=None
+        )
+        delayer.skip_first_delayer = False
+        return delayer
+
+    def negotiate(self, delayer, **kwargs):
+        out = delayer._negotiate_should_allow_prefill(**(_QUEUE_ONLY_PASS | kwargs))
+        return out.output_allow, out.output_reason
+
+    def test_threshold_ignores_collapsing_max_prefill_bs(self):
+        # Delayed passes report the waiting queue as their attempted batch
+        # size, so the max_prefill_bs high-watermark falls to the queue length
+        # while the delay runs.
+        delayer = self.make_delayer()
+        self.assertEqual(self.negotiate(delayer), (False, "delay"))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self.negotiate(delayer, max_prefill_bs=11, waiting_queue_len=11),
+            (False, "delay"),
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self.negotiate(delayer, max_prefill_bs=11, waiting_queue_len=15),
+            (True, "wait_success"),
+        )
+
+    def test_prefill_max_requests_caps_the_threshold(self):
+        delayer = self.make_delayer(prefill_max_requests=8)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self.negotiate(delayer, waiting_queue_len=8), (True, "no_wait")
+        )
+
+    def test_queue_trigger_leaves_skip_first_delayer_to_slot_trigger(self):
+        delayer = self.make_delayer()
+        delayer.skip_first_delayer = True
+        self.assertEqual(self.negotiate(delayer), (False, "delay"))
+        self.assertTrue(delayer.skip_first_delayer)
+
+        delayer._curr_state = None
+        slot_only = dict(max_running_requests=60, waiting_queue_len=99)
+        self.assertEqual(self.negotiate(delayer, **slot_only), (True, "no_wait"))
+        self.assertFalse(delayer.skip_first_delayer)
+
+    def test_queue_delay_outlasts_max_delay_passes(self):
+        delayer = self.make_delayer(max_delay_passes=3)
+        for _ in range(8):
+            self.assertEqual(self.negotiate(delayer), (False, "delay"))
+
+    def test_slot_delay_still_capped_by_max_delay_passes(self):
+        delayer = self.make_delayer(queue_min_ratio=None, max_delay_passes=3)
+        slot_only = dict(max_running_requests=60, waiting_queue_len=99)
+        reasons = [self.negotiate(delayer, **slot_only)[1] for _ in range(3)]
+        self.assertEqual(reasons, ["delay", "delay", "wait_timeout"])
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
